verdict.rationale: QBO offers built-in automation like bank transaction rules, custom workflows/fields (Advanced), and automated payment reminders, confirmed by both docs and community mention of 'automatic rules build right into QuickBooks Online.' However, there's no evidence of an AI-native, developer-facing event/trigger system (e.g., webhooks or programmable rule engine) beyond fixed built-in automations, despite an API/MCP server existing.
